pages.title: Unit 1: A Happy Child (Poem)
bulletPoints: My house is red - a little house; A happy child am I.
I laugh and play the whole day long; I hardly ever cry.
I have a tree, a green, green tree, To shade me from the sun;
And under it I often sit, When all my play is done.

pages.title: Unit 1: Fun with Colours & Reading Words
bulletPoints: Colour the happy child’s house in bright red with yellow windows.
Word reading: Boy, Girl, Sun, Tree, House, Green, Red.
Draw lines: Match "I am a boy" and "I am a girl" with the pictures.
Conversation: What is the colour of your house? What colour is the sky?

pages.title: Unit 1: My Family & Sharing
bulletPoints: How many people live in your house? Write their names and count together.
Grandfather, Grandmother, Father, Mother, Brother, Sister, and Baby.
Look in a mirror: What do you see? Draw your own happy smiling face in the circle.
Collect pictures of farm friends: A fluffy cat, a gentle cow, a playful dog, and a woolly sheep.

pages.title: Unit 1: Three Little Pigs (Sonu, Monu, and Gonu)
bulletPoints: Once upon a time there were three little pigs: Sonu, Monu, and Gonu.
Sonu lived in a house of yellow straw; Monu lived in a house of wooden sticks.
Gonu worked hard and built a sturdy house of red clay bricks.
One day a big bad wolf came: "I will huff and I will puff and I will blow your house down!"

pages.title: Unit 1: The Strong Brick House
bulletPoints: The wolf blew down the straw house and the stick house with great huffs.
Sonu and Monu ran terrified to Gonu’s sturdy brick home.
The wolf huffed and puffed with all his might, but could not blow down the solid brick house!
The three little pigs lived happily and safely together in the red brick house.

pages.title: Unit 2: After a Bath (Poem)
bulletPoints: After my bath I try, try, try To wipe myself till I’m dry, dry, dry.
Hands to wipe and fingers and toes, And two wet legs and a shiny wet nose.
Just think how much less time I’d take If I were a dog and could shake, shake, shake!

pages.title: Unit 2: The Bubble, the Straw and the Shoe
bulletPoints: Once upon a time there lived three friends: The Bubble, the Straw and the Shoe.
One day they went into the forest and came to a wide, rushing river.
The Shoe said: "Straw, stretch yourself across the water so we can walk over."
Straw stretched, but when Shoe jumped on Straw, it broke! Shoe fell with a splash, and Bubble burst with laughter!

pages.title: Unit 3: One Little Kitten (Counting Animals)
bulletPoints: One little kitten, two big cats, Three baby butterflies, four big rats.
Five fat fishes, six sad seals, Seven silly seagulls, eight happy eels.
Nine nervous lizards, ten brave bees, Eleven fat elephants, twelve fat fleas!
Thirteen alligators, fourteen whales, Fifteen friendly donkeys with fifteen tails!

pages.title: Unit 3: Lalu and Peelu
bulletPoints: There was a mother hen who had two little chicks: Lalu and Peelu.
Lalu was red and loved red things; Peelu was yellow and loved yellow things.
One day Lalu saw something red on a plant and ate it—it was a super hot red chili!
Lalu’s tongue burned and he screamed! Peelu ran and brought a sweet yellow jaggery ball to soothe his mouth.

pages.title: Unit 4: Once I Saw a Little Bird (Poem)
bulletPoints: Once I saw a little bird Come hop, hop, hop;
I cried, "Little bird, will you stop, stop, stop?"
I was going to the window To say, "How do you do?"
When he shook his little tail, And far away he flew!

pages.title: Unit 4: Mittu and the Yellow Mango
bulletPoints: Mittu was a parrot: A green parrot with a bright red beak who loved to fly.
Looking down, he saw a big yellow mango hanging high on a mango tree.
A big black crow shouted: "Caw, caw! Go away, this is my tree!" with a harsh loud voice.
Clever Mittu found a red balloon, flew under the crow, and pecked it: POP! The crow flew away terrified!

pages.title: Unit 5: Merry-Go-Round & Circle
bulletPoints: I climbed up on the merry-go-round, And it went round and round;
I climbed up on a big brown horse, And it went up and down.
Story of Circle: Grandmother drew a circle. Mohini added three lines to make a bouncy ball!
Then they drew balloons, the full moon, the bright sun, and yummy round rotis.

pages.title: Unit 6: If I Were an Apple
bulletPoints: If I were an apple and grew on a tree, I think I’d drop down on a nice boy like me.
I wouldn’t stay there giving nobody joy; I’d fall down at once and say, "Eat me, my boy!"
Vocabulary discovery: Apple, Boy, Joy, Tree, Fall, Ground, Nice, Sweet.

pages.title: Unit 7: A Kite & Our Animal World
bulletPoints: I often sit and wish that I could be a kite up in the sky,
And ride upon the breeze and go whichever way the wind blew.
Animal homes: Farm animals (cow, horse, sheep), Water animals (frog, crocodile, fish), Jungle animals (lion, giraffe, monkey).
Help baby animals find their parents through the winding green meadow maze.

pages.title: Unit 8: The Flying-Man & Learning Celebration
bulletPoints: "Flying-man, Flying-man, Up in the sky, Where are you going to, Flying so high?"
"Over the mountains, and over the sea! Flying-man, Flying-man, Can’t you take me?"
Class 1 English Celebration: You have read poems, fables, animal songs, and color words.
Keep singing, speaking, and enjoying the magic of reading every day!
